deviations.what: Missing cpc_subclass values are overwritten with the string "NA", so missing classes enter the base and forward sets and are counted as a class, which the spec forbids.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: filing-year dating, the first-listed filter and its FALSE branch, the base window fy+1..fy+5 and forward window fy-1..fy-3 (t excluded from both), the anti-join for new classes, NA on an empty base, 0 on an empty forward set, and deduplicated output with the specified columns. Focal years come from firm_year rather than a hard-coded 1987-2015, which fits the spec's input definition; line 12 also edits the caller's patent_class in place when first_listed_only is FALSE.
